# Artificial Jobs

> Paid AI training jobs for domain experts (lawyers, doctors, engineers, scientists, linguists) and data partnerships for companies, sourced from micro1 and refreshed daily. Apply links include our micro1 referral code.

## Pages

- [AI training jobs](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/): all open roles, ranked by pay
- [micro1 review](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/micro1): what micro1 pays by field (live data), how its AI interview works, and whether it is legit
- [Sell company data](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/sell-company-data): micro1 data partnerships for operating and defunct companies ($100K–$2M+ per approved data package, per micro1)
- [About](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/about): who runs Artificial Jobs, how listings are sourced from micro1 and ranked by pay, and how referral fees work

## Guides

- [How Much Do AI Training Jobs Pay? Real Rates From Every Open Listing](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/blog/how-much-do-ai-training-jobs-pay): Median and top hourly rates for AI training jobs by field, from every open micro1 listing, refreshed daily.
- [AI Training Jobs for Lawyers: What the Work Is and What It Pays](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/blog/ai-training-jobs-for-lawyers): What AI training work for attorneys involves, which practice areas are hiring, and what it pays, from live micro1 listings.
- [AI Training Jobs With No Experience: What’s Actually Open](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/blog/ai-training-jobs-no-experience): The generalist and language AI training roles you can get without professional credentials, what they pay, and how to avoid scams.
- [How to Sell Your Company’s Data to AI Labs](https://www.artificialjobs.dev/blog/how-to-sell-company-data-to-ai-labs): What AI labs buy, what micro1 ($100K–$2M+) and Mercor (up to $1.5M) pay companies, how the process works and what to check before you sell.
